systems.platform: Dermalog equipment; card produced by M-SI (Mali)
systems.owner: Minister in charge of security; biometric data handled by the Cellule de traitement des données d'état civil (CTDEC)
systems.tiers: national; compulsory from age 15, replaces the NINA card, the national identity card and the consular card
national; NINA card production and issue ends when the biometric card enters into force

note: Reports Décret n°2022-0639/PT-RM of 3 Nov 2022 instituting the biometric card, but gives no law behind it and does not say the system runs on a decree alone; a decree is not a law in force, so no standing or cover fact.
